assumptions: Boundary is PROV-SITE-001, precision provisional_rough
Official announcement states ~11.4 km2 (11,400,000 m2) as a rounded figure
All area metrics must be recomputed when an official polygon is provided
total_site_area_sqm.derivation: Computed area of the PROV-SITE-001 provisional boundary polygon reprojected to EPSG:4548 = 11,412,825.386 m2 (11.4128 km2). The official announcement rounds this to ~11.4 km2 (11,400,000 m2); the 18,825 m2 gap is rounding + provisional-boundary precision, not a factual discrepancy. Boundary is provisional_rough; recompute on official polygon.

assumptions: Design target, NOT a measured/achieved result
Requires official boundary + current land-use survey to verify
green_coverage_ratio.derivation: Design target: green + water coverage >= 40%. This is a planning objective, not a measured outcome. The spatially computed green_ratio under the provisional boundary is 0.35345 (see green_ratio) because the provisional green_space footprint is smaller than the target envelope.

assumptions: Computed from provisional green_space footprint
Will change with official boundary and detailed green network design
green_ratio.derivation: Computed from green_space.geojson polygon area / site_boundary area (EPSG:4548). Represents the directly drawn green + water footprint under the provisional boundary; lower than the 40% design target (see green_coverage_ratio).

sponge_capture_rate_ratio.formula: target: annual runoff capture rate per Sponge City guideline, corresponding to 33.6mm design rainfall
assumptions: Design target, NOT a modeled result
Requires hydrology, drainage-system and rainfall data to verify
sponge_capture_rate_ratio.derivation: Design target: annual runoff capture rate >= 85% (33.6mm design rainfall) per Sponge City guideline. No hydraulic model has been run; figure of 50 facilities is conceptual (see sponge_facilities_count).

renewable_energy_share_ratio.formula: target: renewable energy / total energy consumption >= 20%
assumptions: Design target, NOT a modeled result
Requires building/regional energy load, rooftop availability, geological and municipal capacity data
renewable_energy_share_ratio.derivation: Design target: renewable energy share >= 20% (15 MWp PV + ground-source/water-source heat pumps). No energy model performed; 15 MWp is a conceptual estimate pending rooftop and load data.

assumptions: Design target, NOT a measured result
Requires OD survey and walk-network analysis to verify
green_mode_share_ratio.derivation: Design target: slow-mobility + public-transit mode share >= 60%. No OD survey or network analysis performed; 100% 500m public-space coverage (see public_space_500m_coverage_ratio) is likewise a target, not a network-analysis result.

public_space_500m_coverage_ratio.formula: target: share of site within 500m walking distance of public space = 100%
assumptions: Design target, NOT a network-analysis result
Requires pedestrian-network and service-radius analysis to verify
public_space_500m_coverage_ratio.derivation: Design target: 100% of site within 500m walking distance of public space. No service-radius / network analysis performed; the directly drawn public_space footprint ratio is 0.174632 (see public_space_ratio).

total_gfa_sqm.formula: conceptual estimate from land-use allocation (gross FAR ~1.1-1.2)
assumptions: Conceptual estimate only
Pending official regulatory plan (control plan) data
total_gfa_sqm.derivation: Conceptual estimate of total building floor area (~13 million m2, gross FAR ~1.1-1.2) derived from land-use allocation. NOT based on official regulatory-plan parameters; must be re-derived with control-plan data.

ai_scenario_nodes_count.reason: Conceptual target of 50+ nodes; exact count depends on implementation detail beyond concept-design scope.

talent_apartment_ratio.formula: recommendation: 15% of residential GFA as talent apartments
assumptions: Concept recommendation, not a committed/approved figure
Pending housing policy and regulatory confirmation
talent_apartment_ratio.derivation: Concept recommendation: 15% of residential GFA allocated as talent apartments. Not a government commitment.

annual_ai_events_count.reason: Operational vision of 100+ events/year; not a government commitment, depends on future operational planning.

phased_projects_count.formula: count of named projects in proposal chapter 9 (4 near-term + 5 mid-term + 4 long-term = 13)
assumptions: phasing.geojson currently spatializes 7 representative pilot projects (3 near + 2 mid + 2 long); the remaining 6 are described in text only
Project list is conceptual and subject to official planning
phased_projects_count.derivation: Count of named projects in the proposal narrative (chapter 9): 4 near-term + 5 mid-term + 4 long-term = 13. NOTE: phasing.geojson spatializes 7 representative pilot projects; the other 6 are text-only. Previously stated as 15 in error; corrected to 13 to match the enumerated narrative.

sponge_facilities_count.formula: 32 rain gardens + 6 detention water bodies + 12 sunken green spaces (conceptual)
assumptions: Conceptual facility count
Pending detailed sponge-system design
sponge_facilities_count.derivation: Conceptual count: 32 rain gardens + 6 detention water bodies + 12 sunken green spaces = 50. Not yet located in GIS; conceptual only.

site_area_sqm.formula: alias of total_site_area_sqm (provisional SITE_BOUNDARY area, EPSG:4548)
assumptions: Provisional boundary; recompute on official polygon
site_area_sqm.derivation: Alias for total_site_area_sqm; provisional SITE_BOUNDARY area (EPSG:4548) = 11,412,825.386 m2.

assumptions: Direct polygon coverage, NOT 500m service radius
Requires network analysis for service-radius coverage
public_space_ratio.derivation: Computed from public_space.geojson polygon area / site_boundary area (EPSG:4548). Represents direct polygon coverage only, not the 500m service-radius coverage claimed as a target (see public_space_500m_coverage_ratio).
